sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: Italian brand Ceramiche Keope has recreated the subtle allure of limestone in its Grace collection of porcelain stoneware tiles. The Grace collection was created with reference to limestone from the region of Saint Antoine d'Auberoche in France, a popular source of stone for European buildings throughout the 19th century.
